svg.text: Chip bags: H0: μ = 100 g, σ = 10, two-tailed at α = 0.05. Both samples average 98 g, a 2 g gap below the claim.
n = 25: sample means spread out (SE = 2 g)
−1.0 is inside ±1.96 → fail to reject H0
n = 400: sample means bunch up (SE = 0.5 g)
Dividing by the standard error turns "2 g away" into "how many standard errors away".
With more data, sample means bunch tighter around 100, so the same 2 g gap becomes far more surprising.
